description: The record of an adaptation decision: the rung chosen (including "do not adapt"), the method, data, eval gate, serving and artifact, with forces, alternatives and consequences.
The executable part: rung and method, data sizes and rules, eval thresholds, baseline and rerun triggers, runtime, quantization and memory, base model, revision and supply-chain checks.
The best setup below the chosen rung. A fine-tune must beat it on the frozen eval set to justify the climb.
An event that produces a new artifact (new data, new base revision, new quantization, runtime upgrade) and therefore reruns the eval gate.
A hard rule (license, publisher, file format, remote code, data contract) applied before comparing scores.
